name: Mystery Key

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Try it in a lock
powers.text: A 5 percent chance it opens any lock; if it does, the key disappears.

summary: It has a 5 percent chance of opening any lock, then it vanishes.
text: Insert this question-mark-headed key into any lock and there's a 5 percent chance it opens. The first time it does unlock something, the key vanishes.
